description: This file defines the WebBridge class, which implements plugin interfaces for WebSocket communication, dispatching, and plugin extension within the WPEFramework. It includes nested classes for managing observers, requests, configuration, and internal state, along with methods for initialization, message handling, and subscription management.

classes.name: WebBridge
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing plugin, dispatcher, and WebSocket interfaces with internal state management, observer pattern, and message handling.

classes.name: WebBridge::Observer
classes.description: Represents an observer with an ID and designator, supporting comparison operators.

classes.name: WebBridge::Request
classes.description: Represents a request with channel ID, sequence ID, and timestamp.

classes.name: WebBridge::Cleaner
classes.description: A worker pool job class responsible for cleanup operations.

classes.name: WebBridge::Config
classes.description: Configuration container with JSON serialization for timeout and bind address.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin with the service shell.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound messages by ID and element.

methods.name: HasMethodSupport
methods.description: Checks if a method is supported in a given version map.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Determines the destination state and handler based on designator.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Registers an observer for an event.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes an observer from an event.
